_comment: The branch ruleset for main, written and NOT APPLIED. Measured 2026-08-22: POST
/repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets returns HTTP 403, 'Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository
public' - branch protection is not available for a private repository on a free personal account.
OPEN-020 tracks the gap; this file exists so that closing it is one command rather than a design
session, and so that the claim 'the ruleset is written' can be checked rather than believed.
required_approving_review_count is 0 deliberately. There is one maintainer, and GitHub does not
permit approving your own pull request - requiring an approval would deadlock every change the
maintainer makes, and the usual escape is to disable the ruleset, which protects nothing. The
checks are what gate a merge here; raise this to 1 on the day there is a second person who can
The three contexts are the job names in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Renaming a job there without
renaming it here is how a required check quietly stops being required.
name: main
